english: Tap the camera to scan your first document.
target: Tocca la fotocamera per scansionare il tuo primo documento.
backtrans: Tap the camera to scan your first document.

target: Qualcosa è andato storto durante l'esportazione.

english: Documents inside will not be deleted.
target: I documenti al suo interno non verranno eliminati.
backtrans: The documents inside it will not be deleted.

english: No documents in this folder yet.
target: Nessun documento in questa cartella ancora.
backtrans: No documents in this folder yet.

english: This folder is no longer available.
target: Questa cartella non è più disponibile.
backtrans: This folder is no longer available.

english: This isn't automatic sync. Export creates a single encrypted backup file you move to your new device yourself, then import there.
target: Questa non è una sincronizzazione automatica. L'esportazione crea un singolo file di backup crittografato che sposti tu stesso sul nuovo dispositivo, poi lo importi lì.
backtrans: This is not an automatic sync. The export creates a single encrypted backup file that you move yourself to the new device, then you import it there.

english: Could not import this backup. Check the password and try again.
target: Impossibile importare questo backup. Controlla la password e riprova.
backtrans: Unable to import this backup. Check the password and try again.

target: Questo file di backup sembra danneggiato.

english: {count, plural, =1{1 document imported} other{{count} documents imported}}
target: {count, plural, =1{1 documento importato} other{{count} documenti importati}}
backtrans: {count, plural, =1{1 document imported} other{{count} documents imported}}

english: Pricing is still loading — try again in a moment.
target: I prezzi sono ancora in caricamento: riprova tra un momento.
backtrans: Prices are still loading: try again in a moment.

target: Questa azione non può essere annullata.

english: This scan is no longer available.
target: Questa scansione non è più disponibile.
backtrans: This scan is no longer available.

english: Something went wrong. Please try again.
This will undo all filters, rotations, crops, resizes, and eraser strokes on this page.
target: Questo annullerà tutti i filtri, rotazioni, ritagli, ridimensionamenti e tratti della gomma su questa pagina.
backtrans: This will undo all filters, rotations, crops, resizes and eraser strokes on this page.

english: Front side captured. Now capture the back side.
target: Fronte acquisito. Ora acquisisci il retro.
backtrans: Front captured. Now capture the back.

english: Use your saved signature or draw a new one?
target: Usare la firma salvata o disegnarne una nuova?
backtrans: Use the saved signature or draw a new one?

english: No documents to batch export. Scan some first.
target: Nessun documento da esportare in batch. Scansiona prima qualche documento.
backtrans: No documents to export in batch. Scan some documents first.

english: No folders yet. Create one from the home screen.
target: Nessuna cartella ancora. Creane una dalla schermata iniziale.
backtrans: No folders yet. Create one from the home screen.

english: Copy text to clipboard after scan
target: Copia il testo negli appunti dopo la scansione
backtrans: Copy the text to the clipboard after scanning

target: Riproduci suono al completamento della scansione
backtrans: Play sound when the scan is completed

target: Feedback aptico al completamento della scansione
backtrans: Haptic feedback when the scan is completed

english: DOCX sources render poorly as pages — save inside the app is limited to JPG/PNG from image, PDF, TXT or CSV sources. Use Export & Share for this file.
target: Le fonti DOCX vengono renderizzate male come pagine: il salvataggio all'interno dell'app è limitato a JPG/PNG da immagini, PDF, TXT o fonti CSV. Usa Esporta e condividi per questo file.
backtrans: DOCX sources are rendered badly as pages: saving inside the app is limited to JPG/PNG from images, PDF, TXT or CSV sources. Use Export and share for this file.

english: To save inside the app, choose JPG or PNG. Other targets are exported as files.
target: Per salvare all'interno dell'app, scegli JPG o PNG. Altri target vengono esportati come file.
backtrans: To save inside the app, choose JPG or PNG. Other targets are exported as files.

english: Tap a spot to sample its color
target: Tocca un punto per campionare il colore
backtrans: Tap a point to sample the color

target: OCR non disponibile su questo dispositivo.
backtrans: OCR not available on this device.

english: Your device doesn't support the advanced document scanner. Take a photo with your Camera app, then tap Import below to crop and save it.
target: Il tuo dispositivo non supporta lo scanner documenti avanzato. Scatta una foto con l'app Fotocamera, poi tocca Importa sotto per ritagliarla e salvarla.
backtrans: Your device does not support the advanced document scanner. Take a photo with the Camera app, then tap Import below to crop and save it.

target: Fatturazione non disponibile: riprova più tardi.
backtrans: Billing not available: try again later.

english: No internet. Connect once to download the language pack.
target: Nessuna connessione internet. Connettiti una volta per scaricare il pacchetto lingua.
backtrans: No internet connection. Connect once to download the language pack.

english: Language pack downloading or not ready. Try again shortly.
target: Pacchetto lingua in download o non pronto. Riprova tra poco.
backtrans: Language pack downloading or not ready. Try again shortly.
Cancel [??: "Annulla" literally means cancel; used here as the undo action, may be ambiguous]
Type the text to fill in

english: YOUR DOCUMENTS STAY ON YOUR DEVICE
target: I TUOI DOCUMENTI RESTANO SUL TUO DISPOSITIVO
backtrans: YOUR DOCUMENTS STAY ON YOUR DEVICE
SEARCH [??: "CERCA" is the imperative verb "search!", not a noun]

english: Your entire document office — scan, edit, sign, and export — in one private app.
target: Il tuo intero ufficio documenti: scansiona, modifica, firma ed esporta in un'unica app privata.
backtrans: Your entire document office: scan, edit, sign and export in a single private app.

english: Annotate, sign, watermark, fill forms, seal, and more — every tool free and unlimited.
target: Annota, firma, filigrana, compila moduli, sigilla e altro: ogni strumento gratuito e illimitato.
backtrans: Annotate, sign, watermark, fill in forms, seal and more: every tool free and unlimited.

english: Use KatharScan in {count} languages. OCR runs on your phone — nothing ever leaves your device.
target: Usa KatharScan in {count} lingue. L'OCR gira sul tuo telefono — niente lascia il tuo dispositivo.
backtrans: Use KatharScan in {count} languages. The OCR runs on your phone — nothing leaves your device.

english: E-sign contracts, type-to-fill forms, and stamp enterprise seals in seconds.
target: Firma elettronicamente contratti, compila moduli e applica sigilli aziendali in pochi secondi.
backtrans: Electronically sign contracts, fill in forms and apply company seals in a few seconds.

english: Every edit stays reversible — undo, redo, and revert to original anytime.
target: Ogni modifica rimane reversibile: annulla, ripeti e ripristina all'originale in qualsiasi momento.
backtrans: Every edit stays reversible: undo, redo and restore to the original at any time.

english: No account, no cloud, no watermarks. Your documents never leave your device.
target: Nessun account, nessun cloud, nessuna filigrana. I tuoi documenti non lasciano mai il tuo dispositivo.
backtrans: No account, no cloud, no watermark. Your documents never leave your device.

english: Support KatharScan with a one-time purchase. All features remain free.
target: Supporta KatharScan con un acquisto una tantum. Tutte le funzionalità rimangono gratuite.
backtrans: Support KatharScan with a one-time purchase. All features remain free.

target: Tutte le funzionalità gratuite per sempre

english: This is a non-consumable purchase. Restore it anytime on any device with the same store account.
target: Questo è un acquisto non consumabile. Ripristinalo in qualsiasi momento su qualsiasi dispositivo con lo stesso account dello store.
backtrans: This is a non-consumable purchase. Restore it at any time on any device with the same store account.

english: KatharScan ran into a problem displaying this screen. Your scans are safe — they're stored on this device and this doesn't affect them.
target: KatharScan ha riscontrato un problema nella visualizzazione di questa schermata. Le tue scansioni sono al sicuro: sono memorizzate su questo dispositivo e questo non le riguarda.
backtrans: KatharScan encountered a problem displaying this screen. Your scans are safe: they are stored on this device and this does not concern them.

target: Nessuna scansione corrisponde alla tua ricerca.

english: No folders yet. Tap the folder icon to create one.
target: Nessuna cartella ancora. Tocca l'icona della cartella per crearne una.
backtrans: No folders yet. Tap the folder icon to create one.

english: No favorites yet. Tap the star icon on a document to add it.
target: Nessun preferito ancora. Tocca l'icona della stella su un documento per aggiungerlo.
backtrans: No favorites yet. Tap the star icon on a document to add it.

english: Share it with friends who need a powerful document scanner.
target: Condividilo con amici che hanno bisogno di uno scanner documenti potente.
backtrans: Share it with friends who need a powerful document scanner.

english: Your feedback helps us grow and keeps the app free.
target: Il tuo feedback ci aiuta a crescere e mantiene l'app gratuita.
backtrans: Your feedback helps us grow and keeps the app free.

target: Acquisizione carta d'identità a due lati: Fronte + Retro
backtrans: Two-sided identity card capture: Front + Back

english: Welcome to KatharScan! This is the first public release featuring unlimited scanning, 29 languages, and export to PDF, Word, TXT, JPG, PNG, and CSV.
target: Benvenuto in KatharScan! Questa è la prima release pubblica con scansione illimitata, 29 lingue ed esportazione in PDF, Word, TXT, JPG, PNG e CSV.
backtrans: Welcome to KatharScan! This is the first public release with unlimited scanning, 29 languages and export to PDF, Word, TXT, JPG, PNG and CSV.

english: Allow background reminders for unexported documents
target: Consenti promemoria in background per documenti non esportati
backtrans: Allow background reminders for unexported documents

english: Allow the app to occasionally ask for a rating
target: Consenti all'app di chiedere occasionalmente una valutazione
backtrans: Allow the app to occasionally ask for a rating

english: Allow the app to occasionally suggest sharing
target: Consenti all'app di suggerire occasionalmente la condivisione
backtrans: Allow the app to occasionally suggest sharing
RESERVED [??: "RISERVATO" could mean reserved/restricted/confidential; ambiguous as watermark]

english: The pages could not be attached to the email. Use Share to send the pages.
target: Non è stato possibile allegare le pagine all'email. Usa Condividi per inviare le pagine.
backtrans: It was not possible to attach the pages to the email. Use Share to send the pages.

english: This document has no text yet. Run OCR on it first.
target: Questo documento non contiene ancora testo. Esegui prima l'OCR.
backtrans: This document does not contain text yet. Run OCR first.

english: Your latest changes could not be saved.
target: Non è stato possibile salvare le ultime modifiche.
backtrans: It was not possible to save the latest changes.

english: Tap the page where you want to type
target: Tocca la pagina nel punto in cui vuoi scrivere
backtrans: Tap the page at the point where you want to write

english: This PDF has {count} pages. Pages that are pictures are read with OCR (about 10 seconds each); pages with real text are instant.
target: Questo PDF ha {count} pagine. Le pagine immagine vengono lette con OCR (circa 10 secondi ciascuna); quelle con testo reale sono istantanee.
backtrans: This PDF has {count} pages. Image pages are read with OCR (about 10 seconds each); those with real text are instant.

english: Draw or type a new one
backtrans: Draw or type a new one

english: Check the pages (the document has {count} pages)
target: Controlla le pagine (il documento ha {count} pagine)
backtrans: Check the pages (the document has {count} pages)

english: Couldn't find the page edges. Drag the corners.
target: Bordi non trovati. Trascina gli angoli.
backtrans: Edges not found. Drag the corners.

english: Enlarging doesn't add detail — the page may look soft.
target: Ingrandire non aggiunge dettagli: la pagina può apparire sfocata.
backtrans: Enlarging does not add details: the page may look blurry.

target: Adatta automaticamente al colore della pagina
backtrans: Automatically adapt to the page color

english: Delete {count} pages? They are removed when you save.
target: Eliminare {count} pagine? Vengono rimosse al salvataggio.
backtrans: Delete {count} pages? They are removed on saving.

english: Could not get under {mb} MB; sent the smallest version.
target: Impossibile scendere sotto {mb} MB; inviata la versione più piccola.
backtrans: Unable to go below {mb} MB; the smallest version was sent.
